files.summary: Defines the SiteDocument entity, associating a document with a Site by IDs.
files.purpose: Represents a document attached to a site within the application, likely for storage or reference.

files.summary: Implements the staff administration welcome page with filtering and viewing of student employment applications.
files.purpose: Allows staff admins to view, filter, and manage student employment applications, with support for filtering by site, discipline, and date range, and includes validation and error/warning display.

workflows.name: Employment Application Filtering and Display
steps: Initialize filters for Site, Discipline, Date range, and Withdrawn status on page load.
On any filter change (site/discipline/date), refresh the view and requery the data.
Validate date inputs (required, proper format, EndDate after StartDate)
Display filtered employment applications in a grid with name, program, site, submitted date, and status.
Show/hide error and warning panels as appropriate.
Allow navigation to application details or sending email.

business_rules: End date must not be before start date.
Start and end dates are required and must match date format.
Withdrawn applications can be hidden or shown based on user preference.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator on start and end date fields.
RegularExpressionValidator on start and end date formats.
CustomValidator to ensure EndDate is after StartDate.
conditions: Show warning panel if warnings occur.
Show error panel if errors occur.
Show/hide last login panel depending if last login exists.
system_behavior: Page reloads and data rebinds to grid on filter changes.
Error and warning messages are managed and presented using dedicated panels.
Client-side and server-side scripts for calendar and input support.

files.summary: Defines the ServiceCode entity and supporting methods for listing and retrieving service codes for courses and timetables.
files.purpose: Represents different service codes, categories, and associated translations, used in course and timetable configuration.

workflows.name: Service Code Retrieval
steps: List all service codes by querying ServiceCodeListAll for the session.
Retrieve program/timetable-specific service codes (by CourseID or TimetableID) using ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID or ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID.

business_rules: If alternate language is enabled in the session, use NameAlt and NotesAlt fields instead of Name and Notes.
conditions: Session may be set to alternate language; fields localized accordingly.
system_behavior: DB procedures are invoked for listing and retrieving service code data.

files.summary: Defines SiteProfileHistory and its management, tracking changes and actions performed on a site's profile.
files.purpose: Tracks historical changes to a site profile for audit and display, including user and agency context.

workflows.name: Site Profile History Search
steps: Search for history entries by SiteID and SessionAgencyID.
For each entry, record action details, user info, and agency context.
Localize fields if alternate language is enabled in the session.

business_rules: If alternate language is enabled, display alternate text fields for screen sections, user actions, and fields.
system_behavior: Data is returned with formatted names and phone details where available.
User/agency formatting encapsulated in tooltip methods.

files.summary: Manages email popup documents, including searching and deleting files tied to email operations.
files.purpose: Represents email attachment files in popups, supporting add, list and delete functionalities.

workflows.name: Email Popup Document Search and Delete
steps: Split input data string to extract individual document details.
Create EmailPopupDocument objects for each file with FileName and FilePath.
To delete, remove both file and parent folder on disk based on stored path.

business_rules: On delete, attempt to delete the file and its containing folder.
If alternate language fields are supported, no info found in source.
system_behavior: Handles file operations with error handling (try/catch).
